facts.fact: 夜路上两只鹿站在车灯里，Christian 向左急打方向，其中一只母鹿向右跳，Sundancer 房车直接撞上它：轮胎锁死、车尾甩滑、车身侧倾，驾驶侧三条轮胎一度离地后又落回，险些倾覆。
facts.anchor: Christian jerked left but one of the deer jumped to its right and he plowed into it, locking the tires up in the same moment, the Sundancer’s ass-end skidding around, its top-heavy self leaning, leaning.

facts.fact: 撞击瞬间 Nurse Seine 把 Nate 扑倒在卡座桌面上，双手捧住他易碎的头，并在半空转身用背部撞墙吸收冲击，两人合力压住房车没让它翻。
facts.anchor: Nurse Seine, maybe the only one thinking right, tackled Nate across the aisle onto the booth’s tabletop, both her hands cupping his fragile head, her big body turning around midair so she could absorb the impact into the wall.

facts.fact: 被撞的母鹿被拖到路对面路肩仍有生命体征，Mooch 把藏在右前臂皮囊里的冰锥抵进母鹿下颌关节后方，猛地扎至深处将其杀死，随后在死鹿后腿上擦拭冰锥。
facts.anchor: Mooch jammed the ice pick in hard and deep all at once, opening her fingers wide at the end, her palm against the ball so the point could go deep-deep.

facts.fact: Nurse Seine 低声揭底：Mooch 真名 Rita Kills-in-the-Water，其丈夫 Trace Lomas 曾植物人卧床，她无法忍受便亲手杀夫（Seine 当年在医院工作时听说 Trace 左耳流血、同侧眼睛看向错误方向）；他们乘坐的 Sundancer 房车就是 Trace 的。
facts.anchor: Rita Kills-in-the-Water doesn’t work at the hospital anymore, but she still did when I hired on. She said there was blood coming down from Trace Lomas’s left ear that morning.

facts.fact: 第二只鹿（公鹿）低头冲向众人，Christian 后退到对面路肩躲开；这只救了 Christian 一命、也救了整个任务的公鹿被大卡车的排障器撞上了天。
facts.anchor: The boy deer that had saved his life—saved this whole mission—wasn’t so lucky. That dull cowcatcher launched him up into the sky.

facts.fact: 大卡车约半秒内从横在路中的房车与路边沟之间疾驰而过，两侧余量不到四英寸，后视镜没有刮伤 Sundancer、没削掉任何人的头；Mooch 站在死鹿腿间一步未退。
facts.anchor: The rig took maybe half a second to sweep past, threading the needle between their angled-across-the-road RV and the ditch on the other side of the blacktop, not four inches to spare on either side, its mirrors somehow not gouging the side of the Sundancer, not lopping off any heads.

facts.fact: Nate 在 Christian 张开的嘴里看到：他的舌头曾被锯掉，愈合残端上钉着六颗银色圆头钉（上面两颗像眼睛、下面四颗排成一线），构成一张脸——这就是 Christian 不能说话的原因。
facts.anchor: Stabbed into its stumpy front where it had healed over were six silver studs with round heads, two of them up high like eyes, level with each other, the other four in line with each other below that.

facts.fact: 这次『神圣任务』是把 Heavy Runner 家男孩的骨头从博物馆台阶上带走、送回家，Sebby（Nate 盼望归来的伙伴）藏在暗处、要等他们离开后才能现身；他们必须做不能声张的『秘密英雄』，否则会被联邦追查。
facts.anchor: not able to step out until they’ve left the Heavy Runner boy’s bones… on the museum stoop, yeah.
